example.title: Jens N. and Anna Junker farmstead, house, 45248 316 St

brief: Tall two-storey Queen Anne farmhouse in white clapboard standing on the open prairie: a square corner tower rises a half storey above the eaves under a steep pyramidal roof with a tall finial, and the cross gables are filled with grey-blue fishscale shingles and small attic windows. Dark grey asphalt roofs, a red brick chimney at the centre, tall narrow one-over-one windows. Small hip-roofed porches on slim turned posts sit at the front corner by the tower and at the far end. A white gable-front garage with a blue metal roof stands alongside, and a white board-and-post rail fence runs in front, between the house and a ploughed field.
